content: openai-python: models are pydantic BaseModel but instantiated via a custom construct()/construct_type() path that BYPASSES validation. model_config extra='allow' so unknown response keys are preserved in extra storage rather than dropped or rejected; construct_type returns mismatched values AS-IS instead of raising. Rationale is explicit forward-compatibility with server-side API evolution. No divergence telemetry is emitted -- mismatches are simply invisible. Known failure mode: issue #2204, discriminated union constructs to the wrong member when data does not match exactly.
